summary: Make varieties of ice creams to serve customers.
description:
How do I make some nice changes to the traditional ice cream? Little dessert makers, Baby Panda needs your creativity! Put on your apron and make ice cream!

MAKE CREATIVE DESSERTS
The top 5 creative desserts, including Marshmallow Ice Cream, Pearl Smoothie, Rainbow Popsicle and Chocolate Bowl can all be made in the ice cream cart. Let's get creative and DIY ice cream!

USE A VARIETY OF ITEMS
In the ice cream cart, you can use plenty of ingredients and tools, including eggs, pearls, strawberries, candies, blenders and more. With over 60 kinds of ingredients, 70 cooking tools and 230 decoration items, you can make a hundred types of desserts!

JOIN THE FUN CONTEST
A new chef contest is starting soon! Pick fruits, find food, shake candies and more! There are 6 fun competitions to test your observation and reflexes! What are you waiting for? Take on the challenge and beat other chefs! Come on, concentrate! You can win!

SERVE DIFFERENT CUSTOMERS
What would the customers like to eat? Make different kinds of ice cream according to their preferences! Pay attention to the reaction of your customers when they eat the ice cream. Are they happy or disappointed? This will help you make ice cream that is more suitable for your customer!

Make more ice cream and sell it to more customers, and you will be able to upgrade your ice cream cart. Work hard and you can make it!

Features:
- Rainbow toast, cream cakes, doughnuts, and more are being added to the menu;
- More than 60 types of ingredients, such as banana, yogurt and chocolate;
- Over 70 types of cooking tools like a mixer, whisk, refrigerator for you to use;
- 230+ kinds of sweets like lollipops, marshmallows, cookies for you to decorate your ice cream dessert.
- Participate in 6 fun kitchen competitions;
